exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: (archaic) thought (especially in the plural), aspiration, inclination, intention
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: умы́шленно — deliberately, intentionally; помышле́ние — (archaic) thought (especially in the plural), aspiration, inclination, intention; вы́мысел — invention, fiction, fantasy, figment; мы́сленный — mental.
**вымысел** — вы́мысел: invention, fiction, fantasy, figment; imagination, fancy; falsehood, lie, fabrication.
